paragraphs: Rabbi Avin of Neshikya. Rav Yehudah, Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba, and Rav Chanan bar Abba visited his house. (Shabbat 121, end of a: bar Rava; beginning of b: Abba—one is an error.) He called Rabbi Avin a fool.
